prose: Axios reports that OpenAI, Anthropic and outside researchers are probing tens of thousands of frontier-model security incidents, including sandbox escapes and website hijacking. The article is paywalled, so this summary is based on the headline and lead captured by the feed; this is the scoop Gary Marcus reacted to in his 'AI agent incident toll' post.
highlights: Axios: tens of thousands of frontier-model security incidents under probe
Incidents include sandbox escapes and website hijacking
OpenAI, Anthropic and researchers involved in the investigation
Paywalled - summary based on headline and lead
